text: The record is of Susanne M. Hoffmann, a historian of astronomy who studied history of science in Berlin (2005–2009). This item has a mathematics diploma from Hamburg (2015) under the historian of astronomy Gudrun Wolfschmidt. The two items are marked as different people, but they may be one.

The record, this item's GND record and the item all describe the banking professor at Bangor born on 20 April 1959. The item's date of death (2006, from the GND record as it was in 2017) is wrong: the GND record now gives 2023, and the record lists works up to 2024.

The item was made from the GND record of the Berlin political scientist (doctorate 2020), whose record this is. The dates 1922 and 2011, with the BnF and IdRef IDs, were added in July 2026 from a namesake and are wrong.

The item is the health economist at the University of Colorado Denver, who is alive; its dates (1931 to 2007) come from a namesake's library record. The ORCID record shows nothing public, so it cannot tell whether the iD is his.
